name: email-digest
description: Daily or weekly email summaries in plain language for clients and managers who don't live in chat.

resendApiKey.title: Resend API key
resendApiKey.description: Needed when the provider is resend. Create a sending-only key.

sendgridApiKey.title: SendGrid API key
sendgridApiKey.description: Needed when the provider is sendgrid (Mail Send permission only).

smtpUrl.title: SMTP address
smtpUrl.description: For smtp: smtps://smtp.example.com:465 (implicit TLS) or smtp://smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS). Plain, unencrypted SMTP is refused.

smtpUser.title: SMTP user
smtpUser.description: Leave empty for a relay that needs no login.

smtpPassword.title: SMTP password
smtpPassword.description: Passed to curl on its standard input, never on the command line.

from.title: Sender
from.description: The From address, e.g. Acme Studio <digest@acme.com>. The domain must be verified with your provider.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: Default recipients, comma separated. A project can have its own list: /digest recipients, or the pane.

frequency.title: Send automatically
frequency.description: off (send by hand), daily, weekly, or both (the weekly one replaces the daily on its day).

sendAt.title: Send at
sendAt.description: Local time, HH:MM. A session opened up to 6 hours late still sends; later, that day is skipped.

weeklyDay.title: Weekly digest on
weeklyDay.description: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat or sun.

skipWeekends.title: No daily digest on weekends
skipWeekends.description: Saturday and Sunday are skipped by the daily schedule.

tone.title: Tone
tone.description: client: plain words, no jargon. manager: counts and risks. technical: hashes, authors, CI and test details.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the digest's own words (commit messages stay as written).

includeCost.title: Cost line
includeCost.description: Add the AI usage cost of the period to the digest. Off by default: clients rarely want it.

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Closing text, e.g. your name and studio.

projectName.title: Project name
projectName.description: Name used in the subject. Empty: the project folder's name.

journalDir.title: Journal folder
journalDir.description: Where session-journal writes its day files, relative to the project root.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA zone for the send time and the days covered, e.g. Europe/Rome. Empty: this machine's.
